name: NLP Cloud
description: Long-running NLP API with a $0 plan and $15 of free credit, no card.
overview: NLP Cloud has run a $0 pay-as-you-go plan for years: two parallel requests, all pre-trained models available, and $15 of credit added automatically at signup with no card. The text models include ChatDolphin, Yi-34B, Mixtral-8x7B, GPT-OSS 120B and Llama 3.3 70B, billed per request plus per 1K tokens. It is a native REST API rather than an OpenAI-compatible one, which is the main trade-off for tooling that expects the OpenAI shape.
free_access: $15 credit on the $0 plan, added automatically
